name: Farm
uniques: Can also be built on tiles adjacent to fresh water

civilopediaText.text: Mortal fields that feed the village. Nobody writes songs about them.
Shafts dug into the hills by mortal hands. Jade comes out of some of them.

name: Spring Cave
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+20 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: The sealed cave in which a clan keeps and taps its spring. Raiders know exactly what it is worth.

name: Plantation
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource

civilopediaText.text: Tended beds of moon orchids and other crops. Gu are fed from here.

name: Camp
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource

civilopediaText.text: A hunters' lodge in the forest. Boar and furs come out of it; sometimes the hunters do not.

name: Road
uniques: Can be built outside your borders
Costs [1] [Gold] per turn when in your territory

civilopediaText.text: Mountain paths between villages. They carry caravans, armies and wolves alike.
The den of a beast group (兽巢). Packs keep coming out of it until someone clears it.

civilopediaText.text: A dead Gu Master's sealed legacy (传承). It rewards the lucky and the prepared, and punishes the rest.
